name: Sukatto Arin
source:
Magical girl Alin is a popular heroine of Pangya online golf game. Main character enters golf tournament and challenges Alin with dire consequences on defeat. He wins and thus gains freedom to do anything he wants with her body.　

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔法少女艾琳是网络高尔夫游戏《魔法飞球》中的人气女主角。主人公参加高尔夫比赛，向艾琳发起挑战，并约定败者须承担严酷的后果。主人公赢得比赛，从此可以任意摆布她的身体。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
